scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U recipe -d recipe
scripts.db:migrate: npm exec -w api -- prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: npm exec -w api -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: npm exec -w api -- prisma db seed
scripts.http:nest: npm run db:seed && httpyac send requests.http --all -e nest
scripts.http:dotnet: npm run db:seed && httpyac send requests.http --all -e dotnet
scripts.compare: echo '=== NestJS (port 3000) ===' && npm run db:seed && httpyac send requests.http --all -e nest --json -o body > /tmp/nest.json && echo '=== ASP.NET Core (port 5000) ===' && npm run db:seed && httpyac send requests.http --all -e dotnet --json -o body > /tmp/dotnet.json && echo '=== Compare ===' && node tools/compare-responses.ts /tmp/nest.json /tmp/dotnet.json
